prompts.name: minimal
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished exploration image for a slim topbar HUD for a space strategy browser game. Wide horizontal image, approximately 3:1, front-on flat UI screenshot, sharp readable typography. Show the topbar near the upper third of the image with subdued near-black star-map backdrop below; the UI is the main subject, close enough to inspect. The bar itself is very slim, about 48px tall relative to a 1440px viewport. At exact horizontal center, a prominent clickable turn countdown button is about 220px wide and 88px tall, physically OVERLAID across the bar and extending well below its bottom edge. Button says small 'NEXT TURN' over large '02:14:38'. On the RIGHT of the bar, a single horizontal row of four compact resource icons and quantities: gold credit icon '12,450', steel ingot icon '840', cyan crystal icon '320', green energy bolt icon '1,200'. All four resources entirely right of the center button with clear gap; no overlap. On the left only a tiny geometric empire emblem and 'COSMIC EMPIRES'. No sidebar, no other panels, no extra buttons, no explanatory annotations, no watermark. Clearly distinguish the center button as raised and interactive. Style direction: restrained contemporary sci-fi, flat midnight navy bar, extremely fine cool gray borders, white typography, small crisp resource pictograms with selective color. Center button is a rounded rectangle with a narrow ice-blue outline and subtle shadow, tiny clock glyph above or beside timer, a delicate cyan progress line along its bottom. Clean spacious premium interface, minimal glow.
